Fixed `ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed()` in `django/contrib/admin/options.py`.

**Root cause:** The method treated any relation field whose target field was not in `prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields` as a concrete-inheritance shortcut, dropping the relation part from `relation_parts`. A `OneToOneField(..., primary_key=True)` used as a foreign key (not a parent link) was therefore mistaken for concrete inheritance, so `restaurant__place__country` was collapsed to `restaurant__country`, which isn't in `list_filter`, causing a spurious `DisallowedModelAdminLookup`.

**Fix:** Only apply the shortcut when the previous field is an actual parent link, by adding the condition `getattr(prev_field.remote_field, "parent_link", False)`. The `getattr` guard is needed because reverse relations expose `parent_link` on the rel object while forward `OneToOneField`/`ForeignKey` objects do not.

**Verification:** `scoped_tests` (modeladmin selection, 162 tests) passes: `OK`.
